author: A Hlaalu factor's guide for outlanders
pages:
#Redoran

Warriors, and proud of it. Redoran governs by duty and endures by stubbornness. If a Redoran tells you something will be done, it will be done, possibly by the next generation.

Never insult their ancestors. They are listening.

#Telvanni

Wizards who grow towers out of giant mushrooms and argue for a hundred years about who sits highest. A Telvanni councilor will forget you exist mid-sentence.

Be grateful. The alternative is being remembered.

#Hlaalu

Merchants, and the most reasonable of the Houses, as I am contractually obliged to say. Hlaalu bends so it does not break. Hlaalu deals with outlanders. Hlaalu deals with everyone.

That is why Hlaalu is still here. Mostly.
